core_values: Traditional family values and moral order
Law and order and personal responsibility
Free enterprise with minimal state interference

economic_policy.taxation: Significant cuts to income and corporate taxes; abolish inheritance tax; flat-tax consideration for simplicity; no new taxes under any circumstances.
economic_policy.trade: Bilateral trade deals prioritising national advantage; tariffs to protect strategic domestic industries; skeptical of multilateral trade bodies.
economic_policy.regulation: Aggressively cut red tape; moratorium on new business regulations; abolish agencies that duplicate functions; no climate-related compliance mandates on industry.

social_policy.healthcare: Fully private healthcare system with tax-advantaged savings accounts; oppose any government-run insurance scheme; reduce pharmaceutical regulation to lower costs through competition.
social_policy.education: School choice through vouchers; parent-led curriculum oversight; oppose progressive social content in schools; restore traditional civic and moral education; expand vocational and trade programmes.
social_policy.housing: Remove government from housing markets entirely; slash building regulations; oppose rent controls; promote homeownership through lower taxes, not subsidies.
social_policy.civil_rights: Protect religious liberty as paramount; defend traditional marriage and family structures; oppose gender ideology mandates in public institutions; uphold the right to bear arms without restriction.
social_policy.immigration: Dramatically reduce legal immigration levels; physical border barriers; mandatory detention and deportation for illegal entry; end chain migration and diversity visas; English-language and civic integration requirements.

governance.decentralization: Return power to state and local governments; block-grant federal programmes with fewer strings; dramatically reduce the federal bureaucracy.
governance.transparency: Audit all federal agencies; eliminate wasteful programmes; term limits for all elected officials and senior bureaucrats.
governance.electoral_reform: Strict photo voter ID; proof-of-citizenship requirements; clean voter rolls; oppose ranked-choice voting and mail-in ballot expansion.

environment.climate_action: Oppose carbon taxes, emissions trading, and binding climate targets; climate policy must never compromise economic growth or energy affordability; support voluntary industry innovation only.
environment.energy: Energy dominance through expanded oil, gas, and coal production; fast-track nuclear and hydroelectric permitting; end all renewable energy subsidies and mandates.
environment.conservation: State-led conservation; oppose federal land acquisition; support resource extraction on public lands with reasonable safeguards; protect hunting and rural land-use rights.

security.defense: Peace through overwhelming strength; largest military budget in the world as non-negotiable; modernise nuclear arsenal; demand allies meet spending commitments.
security.law_enforcement: Zero tolerance for crime; mandatory minimum sentences; fully fund and expand police forces; oppose bail reform; crack down on drug trafficking with severe penalties.
security.foreign_policy: Sovereignty-first diplomacy; strong alliances on burden-sharing terms; confront adversaries with credible military deterrence; no foreign aid without clear national interest.
